# Text art styles

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.js from the app's own style definitions. Do not edit by hand: change app/parts/01-data.js or the plugin, then run npm run build. -->

Every style turns the photo, or your lines, into letters. Pick one under **Look** in the Text art panel. Its settings appear below the style tiles, in the style's own section and in Words, Size and Color; the rarer ones are under **More**.

All styles also share the settings in [Settings every style has](#settings-every-style-has) at the end of this page.

## Word cloud

Your words packed inside a shape, biggest first, so the outline of the shape still reads. The signature style of SungFluence.

| Setting | Choices | Starts at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Words | Text, several lines | family love home together care heart ... |
| Shape | Photo, Detailed parts of the photo, Cutout, Word, Heart, Circle, Star, Vector shapes | Photo |
| Shape word or words. Press Enter for a new line. | Text, several lines | LOVE |
| Photo threshold | Slider, 0.05 to 0.95 | 0.45 |
| Swap the shape and the space around it | On or off | Off |
| Largest word | Slider, 20 to 300, or type up to 1500 | 110 |
| Smallest word | Slider, 3 to 40, or type up to 200 | 10 |
| Turn each word | Any of -90°, -45°, 0°, 45°, 90°, 180°, together | 0 |
| Overall turn | Slider, -180 to 180 | 0 |
| Tilt at random | Slider, 0 to 90 | 0 |
| Bigger words | Everywhere the same, Toward the middle, Toward the edge, On the dark parts, On the light parts | Toward the middle |
| How strongly | Slider, 0 to 1 | 0.8 |
| Color | Photo, Ink, Tone, Duotone, Palette | Photo |
| Typeface | Inter, Oswald, Playfair, JetBrains Mono, Special Elite, Naskh (Arabic, Urdu), Nastaliq (Urdu) | Inter |

## Line text

## Settings every style has

Size has **Text size** for every style. The folded sections Mirror, Shape, Finish and Tone come after Color and Background. Click a section name to open it.

### Marks

The switch under the text box. The **?** beside it lists the marks.

| Setting | Choices | Starts at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Marks change the words | On or off | On |

### Mirror

Mirror the writing turns the writing of the layer around, then lays the art out again, so the picture keeps its shape: each letter on the spot, each word read backwards, or each line read from right to left. The same section has Mirror the whole text art, a true mirror of the finished artwork for an iron-on transfer.

| Setting | Choices | Starts at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mirror the writing | Not at all, Each letter, where it stands, Each word, Each line | Not at all |

### Shape

**Draw on** puts the letters only on part of the picture.

| Setting | Choices | Starts at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Draw on | All, Dark, Light, In shape, Out of shape | All |
| Tone split | Slider, 0.05 to 0.95 | 0.5 |
| Shape | Word, Heart, Circle, Star | Word |
| Shape word | One line of text | LOVE |

**Focus and fade** makes the letters fade toward an oval, a circle, a band across the picture, or a column. With the section open, the shape shows on the picture: drag the dot to move it, the square handles to change its size, width and softness, and the round handle to turn it. Hold Shift while turning to snap to 15 degree steps.

| Setting | Choices | Starts at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fade shape | None, Oval, Circle, Band, Column | None |
| Strong part | Center, Outer area | Center |
| Fades | Density, Color, Both | Both |
| Size | Slider, 0.05 to 1.6 | 0.8 |
| Width of the oval | Slider, 0.2 to 3 | 1 |
| Softness | Slider, 0.02 to 1.2 | 0.7 |
| Turn | Slider, -90 to 90 | 0 |
| Center, across | Slider, 0 to 1 | 0.5 |
| Center, down | Slider, 0 to 1 | 0.5 |

**Turn the text** turns each piece where it stands, so the picture keeps its shape.

| Setting | Choices | Starts at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Turn the pieces | Not at all, Each one, Along the picture | Not at all |
| Angles | Any of -90°, -45°, 0°, 45°, 90°, 180°, together | 0 |
| Overall turn | Slider, -180 to 180 | 0 |
| Tilt at random | Slider, 0 to 90 | 0 |
| Break lines and words into single letters first | On or off | Off |

### Finish

**Letter fill** fills the letters with the photo, a soft photo, or makes them holes in a sheet with the photo behind. It works in every style, plugins too.

| Sheet | A color |  |
| Photo in the sheet | Slider, 0 to 1 | 0.85 |
| How much shows | Slider, 0 to 1 | 1 |
| Photo strength | Slider, 0 to 1 | 0.3 |
